content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable provides a comprehensive platform for course creation and sales, but it relies on payment processors like Stripe, which limits its accessibility in numerous countries. Gumroad similarly functions well but faces restrictions that can disrupt service. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, empowers creators by delivering a fully operational online store without dependence on these conventional platforms. This option provides ownership over everything, from payment processing to data.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal explicitly exclude many countries, creating barriers for digital creators. PayPal's unpredictable account suspensions can freeze funds for up to 180 days without appeal, leaving creators vulnerable. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows anyone to set up their payment processing without geographic restrictions. By utilizing solutions like NOWPayments, creators can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring reliable access to funds regardless of their location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed is critical for digital creators. Stripe and PayPal may delay fund availability, while payment suspensions can result in significant cash flow issues. Sovereign commerce infrastructure mitigates these challenges with automatic on-chain verification for crypto payments. NOWPayments only charges a 0.5% fee, and with recommended networks like BSC and Solana, transaction costs remain under $0.10, ensuring that creators retain a larger portion of their earnings.
Sovereign commerce gives you ownership — no more relying on platforms that can restrict access.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of sovereign commerce solutions is ownership. With platforms like Teachable or Gumroad, your data and payment processes are controlled by the provider, leaving you at their mercy. Sovereign commerce stacks provide full control post-deployment, meaning creators own their data and don’t face ongoing platform fees or restrictions. Automation through tools like Google Sheets for order management and Cloudflare for delivery further enhances efficiency, enabling instant product access for buyers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and the number of products you plan to sell. If you're just starting out with a few courses, the Sovereign Starter Stack may suffice. However, for more established creators looking to scale, the Edge Commerce Stack offers robust features that include automated workflows, multiple products, and a secure backend. This stack ensures everything is tested before handoff, providing peace of mind as you launch.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Payment processing should never be geo-restricted; choose infrastructure that empowers your sales.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by assessing your digital product offerings and decide on the stack that fits your needs. Next, set up a free hosting service such as Cloudflare Pages. Integrate backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Connect your order storage to Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, implement NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and ensure your products are loaded for instant delivery.
